name: 01028 · E Longmeadow, MA
findings: ZIP 01028 (E Longmeadow) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01028 (E Longmeadow) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01028 (E Longmeadow) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
